notes.distinct_findings: 'distinct findings' are dedup KEYS. One defect can give two keys (found at replay with an operator id and again by the fuzzer as 'libfuzzer'); distinct_sites gives distinct (class, frame) without the operator id.
notes.k1_apart: Operator decision 2026-10-06: the K1 kinds rust-ub-check and rust-stack-overflow stay in K1 but are listed apart (k1_kinds_found); the scorer prints the K1 count with and without them (the registered K1 text names ASan memory errors only).

rust-stack-overflow (Rust runtime stack overflow abort; ASan stack-overflow is K1 in C, so it is K1 in Rust too)
notes.k1_list_note: The K1 kind list is WIDER than the registered K1 text (which names heap-buffer-overflow, use-after-free, stack or global overflow, SEGV on an unknown address): double-free, bad-free, memcpy-param-overlap, alloc-dealloc-mismatch and others are included, for every arm alike.
notes.k5_key: K5 has no stack, so the dedup key is (K5, <no-frame>, operator id): the registered shape with the frame slot empty, at most 8 keys per arm (O1 to O7 and 'libfuzzer' for a file without an operator id); the oracle violation kinds are NOT in the key and are shown only in sites and the table. K5 files are not minimised. distinct_sites.K5 gives the oracle kinds alone. A C1 K5 count of several is expected: C1 reads 20 named tensors and ignores shape (X7); a loader-size effect, not language.
notes.libfuzzer_defaults: malloc_limit_mb=2048 (libFuzzer default), so an untouched malloc of 1.5 GB is neither K4 nor K1 in any arm; max_len=1048576; with -fork=1 -ignore_crashes=1 -ignore_timeouts=1 -ignore_ooms=1 (X1: one parent and one child process on one core, added so that a crash does not end a 30-minute trial; identical in every arm).
notes.minimised_before_the_key: libFuzzer -minimize_crash keeps ANY crash, so many findings keep the original input as the reproducer (minimisation.kept_original); where that count is high 'minimised before the key' is not true for those findings.
notes.mutant_maker_impurities: O3: 12 of 100 also change shape or dtype; O5: 2 of 100 write 'BF16' (the same JSON); O2: 6 of 100 change padding only. Harmless; equal for every arm.
notes.normaliser: Operator decision 2026-10-06 (revised the same day): the label sentence uses the REGISTERED reading (keys with raw frame names, K1 = the registered ASan kinds only); the wider readings (normalised keys, Rust-only K1 kinds) are printed beside it as rows with no label. raw_keys holds the keys with raw frame names, raw_key_kinds the same with the finding kind appended.
notes.oracle_limits: Oracle rules: a duplicate tensor NAME with different non-overlapping offsets is CONSISTENT (a loader taking the last duplicate is not a K5); a file the oracle calls UNREADABLE (unknown dtype, header past the file) is never K5 even when a loader accepts it; a tensor the loader never reads can still make the file INCONSISTENT (X7).
notes.rust_build_flags: Rust fuzz builds (cargo-fuzz) and the Rust accept builds have debug-assertions and overflow-checks ON (a panic on overflow is K2, informational); the C1 build has no overflow checks (-O2, no -fsanitize=signed-integer-overflow). K2 is informational; the labelled classes do not depend on it, except that a violated unsafe precondition panics and is classified K1 'rust-ub-check'.
